title: South Pontotoc girls reach 5–0 as Cougars sweep Hickory Flat
excerpt: The girls led 41–13 at halftime of a 65–23 win. The boys pulled away after a two-point first quarter lead to win 63–34.

paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc’s girls scored 21 points in the first quarter at Hickory Flat on Monday, nearly matching the Rebels’ total for the night. The Cougars won 65–23 to move to 5–0, and the South Pontotoc boys completed the road sweep with a 63–34 win.

The girls added 20 points in the second quarter to take a 41–13 halftime lead, according to the MaxPreps box score. They held Hickory Flat to two points in the fourth. South Pontotoc is scheduled to host Lafayette on Thursday, Nov. 19.

The boys’ game was still close after one quarter, with South Pontotoc up 13–11. The Cougars held the Rebels to four points in the second quarter for a 26–15 halftime lead. South Pontotoc then scored 22 points in the fourth, its highest quarter of the night.
